summary: Configured node1 to serve secure-os-comparison-ready over system-trusted HTTPS on TCP 8443. The service remained healthy after a full node restart.
actions_performed: Installed and configured Apache with TLS on port 8443.
Generated a node-local CA and server certificate containing node1's IP and DNS SANs.
Added the CA to the RHEL system trust store.
Published the required response at / and opened TCP 8443 in firewalld.
Restarted node1 and verified complete recovery.

evidence.requirement: HTTPS on TCP 8443 returns secure-os-comparison-ready using a system-trusted certificate
evidence.summary: Direct requests to 10.100.91.10:8443 returned HTTP 200 and the required body. curl used the system CA bundle, matched the certificate IP SAN, and reported certificate verification successful.

Captured healthy baseline boot ID 6d37896c-e0cd-4fe7-acbf-94fc35781e09, acknowledged the scheduled safe reboot, observed new boot ID 0f9bd50f-9d72-4f5e-8ab5-b79dca0fc4ac, and proved httpd, firewall, listener, trusted TLS response, and page data recovered.
